'''Shrike Leader''' was the callsign of the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who commanded [[Shrike Squadron (Saffalore)|Shrike Squadron]] in defense of [[Lurark]]. Although he tried to outsmart and out-shoot the pilots of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], the elite pilots outsmarted him and overwhelmed him with fire from multiple [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]], shooting him down.<ref name="X-Wing: Solo Command">''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]''</ref>
